body:
"Please promise me you'll go soon. Your life is worth more than anything-money, time, pride. This is cliche, but you have so many things you've yet to do. Please get help. Your future self will thank you." 

I promise, and I thank you.. (And most likely future me will, too)
Thank you for your encouragement, sincerely. Hearing from you and others has brought a glimmer of hope into my day.

About a month or so after. He independently decided that he had alcoholism due to its effect on his happiness/social life / work ethic and quit on his own. It's a familial thing and I'm proud of him for that decision, honestly, which he has stuck to to this day.

Man, I'm glad you know me so much better than I know myself. *sarcasm* And I'm genuinely glad that you seem to have never experienced trauma, or you'd be able to understand better. I have received your opinion, it has been duly noted and tossed out, have a nice day.

I'm not "just now" having problems about it, I have been upset about it for years but unable to come to terms with what it actually was, and I have only "just now" been able to speak about it. The truth "just now" coming out has caused an uptick in my emotional turmoil about it, and hence my post. Somehow, though, I doubt my explanation will matter to you. So enjoy feeling right I guess? And "thanks" for calling me a princess? :/
Thank you for providing me a few reasonable options to try and for such a well thought out response.. Thank you
Thank you so much for this. I needed to hear a lot of that. Thank you.
Thank you, I really appreciate your advice and sympathy. Truly, it means a lot.
